author: Vertyco
description: Block Blaster for ActivityHub, a remake of Loom Games' phone puzzle Pixel Flow! with its sounds and pictures and all-new cats. Tap colored cats onto a belt around a pixel picture and they shoot away the cubes of their own color, one layer at a time, until the picture is clear. All 2,600 of the original's levels and its boosters, drawn in live 3D, with progress kept by the bot for each player on every server. Watch a friend's level live. Coins are in-game; server admins can also sell boosters for Red currency, which takes credits out of the economy and never pays any out. Still being built: levels 1 to 599 have every feature, later levels bring features that are not in yet. Single player, works on desktop and on phones held upright. Needs ActivityHub 0.8.0 or later.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each player's Discord user ID and their progress (level, coins, boosters and which tips they have seen). It also keeps the IDs of players who bought boosters with credits today, so admins can see how many bought. Progress is deleted when a user requests data deletion.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Block Blaster!

Block Blaster is a game for ActivityHub, which must be installed and set up first:
`[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`
`[p]cog install vrt-cogs activityhub`
`[p]load activityhub`
Then follow ActivityHub's README: https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs/blob/main/activityhub/README.md

Once both are loaded, Block Blaster shows up in the hub's menu.
short: Clear pixel pictures with a belt of shooting cats, an ActivityHub remake of the phone game Pixel Flow!
